title: Dotáhneme změnu: Demokrat na Hrad gathering at Prague Castle
reason: Worker-proposed exclusion: the opened report frames this as an explicitly pre-election gathering supporting presidential candidates rather than documenting a separate government-policy demand. The original manual defines excluded political rallies specifically as two or more political parties demonstrating for their positions in association with upcoming elections. These reports identify a civic-group organizer and supporters of multiple candidates but do not establish two political parties demonstrating; application of that exact rule therefore remains unresolved pending coordinator review.
notes: ČTK reporting in S006 and its CT24 republication in S007 describes higher hundreds at Prague Castle for about 1.5 hours, candidate-support placards and speakers, and an explicit presidential-election focus. The Castle Administration had recommended moving the gathering and organizers disputed whether the site was public space, leaving a possible assembly-right/state-target question. The opened reports name the civic association Milion Chvilek and supporters of Pavel and Nerudová; they do not establish that two or more political parties demonstrated. This is a provisional worker exclusion, not a definitive application of the codebook rule; coordinator review should resolve both the exact rally definition and whether the location dispute was a state-directed demand. S006 and S007 share ČTK origin and are not independent accounts.
